A NOTE FROM INDIEK

Good music travels.

Korean artists and songs I wish more people knew.

Why I made indiek.

I wanted a place to share music I like with people who might not have heard it. There are bands and solo artists here, from indie and folk to pop, hip-hop and R&B.

I add to the selection as I find more music. A song doesn’t have to be new to belong here. Alongside the recordings and live clips, there’s a little about the artists and the stories behind their songs.

indiek is not affiliated with the featured artists, their labels, YouTube or Apple Music.

How the stories are made.

Features published under the indiek name use AI-assisted research, drafting and automated factual and editorial checks. We link the original reporting and release records used in each story. These checks can miss things; corrections are welcome.

We distinguish reported information from interpretation. We do not invent interviews, personal listening memories or visits to a show. An existing interview stays credited to its original publication. A date changes when a story is actually updated, not to make an older article look new.

Guest contributions carry the contributor’s own name and a description of their involvement. Sources and image credits are part of the editing process; a public photograph is not automatically licensed for reuse.

Have a story in mind?

We welcome ideas about music from Korea: a song with an unexpected history, a small scene worth understanding, or a question you have spent time exploring. Send a short pitch, the angle and any relevant writing samples to gw@lumejs.com.

Please tell us what you have researched or experienced yourself and disclose any involvement with the artists. We will discuss editing, credits, rights and any terms before accepting a contribution. Sending a pitch does not transfer your rights or guarantee publication.

Get in touch.

For questions, factual corrections, credit updates, or requests concerning an image or other content, email gw@lumejs.com.

Include the page address and the material you are referring to. For an image request, please describe your connection to the work. Please avoid sending sensitive personal documents in an initial message.
